_doc_note: Shape per the Anthropic web search tool docs, https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/web-search-tool, read 2026-10-05. Confirmed there: the request tool entry {type: web_search_20250305, name: web_search, max_uses} posted to https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages with the anthropic-version: 2023-06-01 header; a search is a server_tool_use block (id srvtoolu_..., name web_search, input.query) followed by a web_search_tool_result block, paired by tool_use_id, whose content lists web_search_result items with url, title, page_age and encrypted_content; text blocks carry citations of type web_search_result_location with url, title, cited_text and encrypted_index, and no character offsets; usage.server_tool_use.web_search_requests counts the searches, billed at $10 per 1,000. The API reference (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/messages/create, same day) types page_age as an optional string or null. The top-level model field is from the Message type in the official anthropic-sdk-python (src/anthropic/types/message.py), read the same day; its snapshot date here is illustrative. Hand-written from those shapes, not a live capture.
